topic_ko: 도덕적 면허와 에코 죄책감 — 빠르고 쉬운 균형 회복
_note: 어휘 중심 지문. vocab 을 특히 견고하게 구성. 정답은 유형별로 ①~⑤ 분산.
writing_passage: Some people are more likely to cheat and steal after purchasing "eco-friendly" products, probably because they feel licensed to do so since they morally account the "eco-friendly" choice as a "good" deed.
Moral licensing has also been observed in the context of cooperation for the good of the environment.
When people are reminded of deeds they have done that they know were harmful to the environment, they might be left with a feeling of "eco-guilt."
People who experience eco-guilt seek pro-environmental actions to compensate for this guilt and restore balance.
In their search for such a balance, people are eager to believe in "quick-fixes," because they want to re-establish the moral balance and escape the guilt as quickly and easily as possible.

In the same way that people may change their attitudes to reduce inconsistencies between attitudes and behavior, people may also change their evaluation of past environmentally burdening behaviors and future environmentally friendly behaviors.
For instance, people are more likely to sign a petition addressing environmental damage after viewing evidence of human-caused environmental damage.

passage: Buying a "green" product can make some shoppers feel entitled to cheat afterwards, because they count that purchase as a good deed.
This moral licensing appears in environmental cooperation as well.
Being reminded of one's own environmentally damaging actions leaves a residue of "eco-guilt."
Those who feel it look for pro-environmental behaviors that will offset the guilt and bring their moral books back into balance.
Because they want relief as fast and as effortlessly as possible, they are drawn to "quick-fixes."
They may even revise how they judge their past damaging acts and their future green ones.
After seeing proof of human-caused damage, for example, people become readier to sign an environmental petition.
Guilt, in short, shapes green behavior more than careful reasoning does.
choices: how green products are tested before they reach consumers
how eco-guilt drives people toward quick moral balancing
why environmental petitions rarely change public policy
how shoppers compare prices between green and ordinary goods
why cheating is more common in wealthy societies
theme.explanation_ko: 선행이 면허가 되고, 환경 죄책감이 생기면 사람들은 그것을 빠르고 쉽게 상쇄하려 친환경 행동과 손쉬운 해결책을 찾는다는 것이 주제이다. ②가 정답.
theme.distractor_ko: ①제품 검증, ③청원의 정책 효과, ④가격 비교, ⑤부유한 사회의 부정행위는 본문의 초점이 아니다.

passage: We should be wary of treating a single green purchase as moral credit.
Research on moral licensing shows that a good deed can license a later bad one.
The same pattern appears when people cooperate for the good of the environment.
Reminded of their own harmful acts, people are left with eco-guilt.
They then chase pro-environmental actions that will compensate for the guilt and restore balance.
Because they want that relief quickly and easily, they are drawn to quick-fixes rather than lasting change.
We ought to judge our environmental behavior by its actual effect, not by how fast it relieves our guilt.
choices: 환경 행동은 죄책감의 해소가 아니라 실제 효과로 평가해야 한다.
친환경 제품의 가격을 낮추어 구매를 장려해야 한다.
환경 청원 서명 운동을 학교 교육에 포함해야 한다.
도덕적 면허 효과에 관한 연구를 더 많이 지원해야 한다.
소비자는 제품의 원산지를 반드시 확인해야 한다.
claim.explanation_ko: 글은 죄책감을 빨리 덜어 주는 손쉬운 해결책에 끌리는 경향을 지적하며, 환경 행동을 실제 효과로 판단하라고 말한다. ①이 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ②가격 인하, ③학교 교육, ④연구 지원, ⑤원산지 확인은 본문이 내세운 주장이 아니다.

vocab.explanation_ko: ③ 죄책감을 보상하는(compensate) 목적은 무너진 도덕적 균형을 되돌리는 것이므로 worsen(악화시키다)은 정반대이며 restore(회복하다)가 적절하다.

order.given: Some people are more likely to cheat and steal after purchasing eco-friendly products, because they morally account the green choice as a good deed.

blocks.A: Those who feel it seek pro-environmental actions to compensate for the guilt and restore their moral balance.
blocks.B: This moral licensing has also been observed when people cooperate for the good of the environment, but it works in the opposite direction as well.
blocks.C: Reminded of deeds they know were harmful to the environment, people may instead be left with a feeling of eco-guilt.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글의 도덕적 면허를 (B)가 환경 맥락으로 확장하며 '반대 방향'을 예고하고, (C)가 그 반대 방향인 eco-guilt를 제시하며, (A)가 'Those who feel it(그것을 느끼는 사람들)'로 이어받는다. (B)-(C)-(A).

summary.summary_template: People troubled by eco-guilt look for green actions that will __(A)__ their moral balance, and because they want relief fast they favor solutions that are __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: 죄책감에 시달리는 사람들은 도덕적 균형을 (A)회복시켜(restore) 줄 행동을 찾으며, 빠른 해소를 원하기에 (B)수고롭지 않은(effortless) 해결책을 선호한다. ④가 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 upset/ignore이 아니라 restore, (B)는 demanding/costly가 아니라 effortless여야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 환경적 죄책감을 경험하는 사람들은 친환경적 행동을 찾는다.
writing.answer: People who experience eco-guilt seek pro-environmental actions.
writing.explanation_ko: 주격 관계대명사 who가 이끄는 절이 주어 People을 수식하고, 본동사는 seek이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그들은 가능한 한 빠르고 쉽게 죄책감에서 벗어나고 싶어 한다.
conditions: as ~ as possible 구문을 사용할 것
escape the guilt 를 포함할 것
writing.answer: They want to escape the guilt as quickly and easily as possible.
writing.explanation_ko: want to V + as + 부사(quickly and easily) + as possible(가능한 한 ~하게).

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: When people are reminded of deeds they have done that they know were harmful to the environment, they might be left with a feeling of "eco-guilt."
writing.answer: 사람들이 환경에 해로웠다고 스스로 알고 있는, 자신이 했던 행동들을 상기하게 되면, 그들에게는 "환경적 죄책감"이라는 감정이 남을 수 있다.
writing.explanation_ko: be reminded of(~을 상기하게 되다), they know는 관계절 안의 삽입절, be left with(~이 남다).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: People who experience eco-guilt seek pro-environmental actions to ___________ for this guilt and restore balance.
writing.explanation_ko: 죄책감을 '보상하다'는 compensate for이며, 뒤의 restore balance와 짝을 이룬다.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Because a green purchase feels like a good deed, some people feel (A)___________ to cheat afterwards; conversely, those reminded of harmful acts feel eco-guilt and act to restore (B)___________.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 선행을 했다고 느끼면 일탈해도 된다는 licensed(허가받은) 감정이 생기고, (B) 죄책감을 느끼는 사람은 balance(균형)를 회복하려 한다.
